description: This file defines the HelpDesk class for the vtiger CRM module, including methods for handling tickets, comments, attachments, related records, report queries, and email content generation.

classes.name: HelpDesk
classes.description: Represents the HelpDesk module in vtiger CRM, managing tickets, comments, attachments, related records, reports, and email notifications.

methods.name: HelpDesk
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the module data, including comments and attachments, and updates related service contracts if applicable.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves related modules, specifically handling updates for ServiceContracts.

methods.name: insertIntoTicketCommentTable
methods.description: Inserts a comment into the vtiger_ticketcomments table.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving file attachments related to a ticket.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to a ticket, such as tasks and events.

methods.name: get_ticket_history
methods.description: Fetches the change history of a ticket.

methods.name: get_ticket_comments_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of comments for a specific ticket.

methods.name: process_list_query
methods.description: Processes a list query and returns results with row count and pagination info.

methods.name: getColumnNames_Hd
methods.description: Returns list of HelpDesk field labels in uppercase without spaces.

methods.name: getCommentInformation
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying comments related to a ticket.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Retrieves the customer name from the portal info for a ticket.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for exporting ticket data in CSV format.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves activity history for a ticket.

methods.name: constructUpdateLog
methods.description: Creates a log string describing updates made to a ticket.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from one ticket to another.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary query part for report related to tickets.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationship between a ticket and another entity.

methods.name: getTicketEmailContents
methods.description: Generates email content for a ticket, including details and comments.

methods.name: getPortalTicketEmailContents
methods.description: Generates email content for portal notifications about a ticket.

methods.name: clearSingletonSaveFields
methods.description: Clears specific singleton save fields like comments.
